document.abstract: The 1080p/24 format has become widely popular for transferring film images to HDTV tape at the native 24 frame/sec film rate. The immediate appeal of 1080p/24 encouraged Sony, Panasonic, and others, to develop 24p cameras, to enable cinematographers to record directly into this video format. This paper is a review of the new format and some of the tools available to take advantage of the technology.
